title: Text: DET Oliver Arias ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hello Oliver, this is Anthony Fenech from the Detroit Free Press, I'm coming to the DR to do a story on Campos next week. Got your number from Tom Moore. Just wanted to touch base and say hello. Save my number, I will add you on WhatsApp.

Hi Mr Fenech Pleasure to meet you. Go it. I will save your number. Will be in touch to Coordinate activities for next week. Have a good night and do not hesitate to contact me if you need me. Take care.
